newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas virtually unchanged, minimal volumes do.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas virtually unchanged, minimal volumes do.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures contract saw only three trades on Friday, with August done once and April twice. A total of 40 lots was transacted.

This was the lowest total of the week. There were 60 lots traded on Monday, 80 on Tuesday, 155 on Wednesday and 115 on Thursday. Mondays and Fridays are often quieter than the middle days of the week, a pattern that is frequently repeated on the OTC market.
Prices were virtually unchanged, with only August seeing a slight downturn. But brokers are unwilling to read much significance into price movements in such a thin market.
In the untraded months, bids and offers were posted in every case by the close of trade but the range between them was too wide to allow liquidity to develop.
